_note: THE WINTER HALL. Storm variants gated on act4_done, as data/dialogue/common.json sets out. The Foundation lead in here is deliberately not a villain and does not know she is one: she is a good scientist who has been told to stop asking about her own cable, and everything she says is true.

lines: Sixteen bunks, and four of them are Frostmere people, and those four go home on Friday.
That is a busy inn again. That is what a busy inn is supposed to be.
Nobody has said a word about the fortnight and nobody is going to. Sit where you like.
Sixteen bunks, and eleven of them are Frostmere people this week.
That is not a busy inn. That is four houses with no fire in them.
Nobody has said a word about it and nobody is going to. Sit where you like.
The board is fuel, not money. If your name is on it you are already welcome.
There is no ledger for this and there never has been. It would only embarrass people.
Nine days out of forty, and then eleven days out of eleven.
I am the best hand on this shore, and it turns out that only means anything when there is ice.
I have stopped saying it was not me in the actual words. I still think it, mind.
Six generations. My grandmother cut through a winter with a broken arm.
I have cut nine days out of forty and I am the best hand on the shore.
It is not me. I keep having to say that to myself in the actual words.
You cut with the grain of the freeze, always. Against it and the block shatters.
You cannot see the grain. You find it with the saw, in the first inch, every time.
Forty years and I still find it. I have never once known it before I started.
Twelve days of identical readings and then one that moved, and I have somewhere to send that now.
I wrote to the girl in Aureline and had a letter back in four days with a figure in it.
Four days. It used to be four acknowledgements.
I have eleven identical days of readings and no explanation I would put my name on.
Weather is a system. Systems do not sit still. This one is sitting still.
I have written that sentence to Aureline four times and had four acknowledgements.
Foundation, but the boring end of it. Barometers. Nobody bothers us up here.
We have a station on the shoulder and another set higher, on the old cut.
That one is not weather. That one is somebody else's project and it draws power.
Three regions, same month, and I have been back over two of them since.
The sea off Tideglass is a sea. The wetlands are wet. This lake is making ice.
I still have no theory. I have a route again, and it is the one I set out with.
Averra is a big place and I have been over a good deal of it, so believe me:
the sea off Tideglass is wrong, the wetlands are wrong, and this lake is wrong.
Three regions. Same month. I do not have a theory. I have a route and I am changing it.
Nine towns in the world sell ice and this is the only one that is not lying about it.
The rest cut river and call it lake. You can taste the difference and I do.
I come four weeks over a mountain for it. Say that out loud and it sounds mad.
